data-gov-my-weather-warning.heading_en: Warning on Strong Wind and Rough Seas
data-gov-my-weather-warning.text_en: SECTION A: FOR MALAYSIAN WATERS [WITHIN 24 NAUTICAL MILES] 1) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Perak • West Johor • Western Sarawak • Western Sabah • Eastern Sabah until 9:00 PM; Friday, 30 October 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats. SECTION B: FOR SHIPPING 1) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Samui • Northern part of Condore • Reef South • Northern part of Reef North • Sulu • Labuan • Northeastern Bunguran • Palawan until 9:00 PM; Friday, 30 October 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats.
data-gov-my-weather-warning.instruction_en: This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous.
data-gov-my-weather-warning.heading_bm: Amaran Angin kencang dan laut bergelora
